name: Hearth Town
scope: Asset pack for review and future integration; current gameplay is unchanged.
style: Original GBA-inspired grassland starter town, warm roofs, green tree canopy, clean top-down paths.

assets.purpose: Close-up environment under independently interactive landmarks.
Transparent town illustration for destination selection; review at 96, 128 and 192 pixels.
Wide countryside section for composing the world map.
Transparent named hit regions; inline for events, use as an image for visual reference only.

worldComposition.edgeTreatment: Full-bleed grass and forest; adjoining sections need authored edge matching. Not a seamless repeating tile.

currentRegionPlacement.note: Existing regional coordinates are reference only. This 1254-square section is not wired into that map.

source.postProcessing: None; original PNG dimensions and alpha preserved.
